   - transformer+weighted: 0.725
   - transformer+concat: 0.721
   - avgpool+weighted: 0.706
   - avgpool+concat: 0.518 (but this was scgpt)

- It uses scvi_n200 (best RNA encoder)
- resnet50 showed competitive F1 (0.694524 in config_017)
- concat is slightly different from weighted

- Alternative fusion (concat) to test if it helps with resnet50
